anchor: Measures named, but not defined, in Keep Britain Working: a national growth opportunity, September 2026 (GOV.UK, updated 9 October 2026); every definition is an OWHS proposal
notes: PROPOSED by RFC 0003, profile-scoped (owhs-uk-measures). The government has named these measures and has not published definitions. Every definition is an OWHS proposal, labelled as such in rfcs/0003-uk-measures-profile/owhs-uk-measures-0.1.0.md. These codes are deliberately not in the reserved whiu: namespace. When the Workplace Health Intelligence Unit publishes its own definitions, this list is deprecated in their favour.
